purpose: A compact AI suggestion with a normalized confidence score and an explicit review reminder.
behaviorProvider: Shared data-grid cell adapter; table/record state remains with its host.

component: Clamp finite confidence into zero through one and map non-finite input to zero. Levels are high at >=0.8, medium at >=0.5, otherwise low.
Expose a focusable span with an accessible phrase identifying an AI suggestion, verdict and full rounded confidence percentage. Its decorative sparkles do not provide the name.
host: Own score computation, evidence provenance and explicit approval/application workflow.
Provide a concise verdict and avoid treating score thresholds as calibrated correctness guarantees.

Tooltip states that this is a suggested verdict and asks for evidence review; the cell does not apply the verdict.

Use data-display group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: The thresholds are display categories; no model scoring, evidence validation or verdict action is implemented.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
